I will apply one bag of NPK fertilizer that I managed to get from the government subsidy on this plot, and I will also spread manure from our goats because the soil here is sandy and needs help. I am using the maize seeds I kept from last year's harvest since I cannot afford the expensive hybrid seeds from the agro-dealers, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves because we have no cash to pay laborers. I will not buy pesticides or herbicides as they cost too much for a maize crop, and we depend only on the rains from June to September because only those with land near the river can irrigate.
